target_roles.title: VP of Product Development
target_roles.rationale: General Formulations already manufactures GF 108 Tedlar overlaminate and actively co-develops anti-graffiti solutions with DuPont. The VP of Product Development would be the strategic decision-maker for expanding the Tedlar product portfolio beyond GF 108 into new applications. With GF showcasing Economy Film & Laminate Solutions at ISA 2025 and launching products like GF 767 Sparkle Holographic Film, this role is actively managing product innovation and differentiation. They would care about: (1) expanding premium product lines with proven 10-20 year durability claims to command higher margins, (2) competitive differentiation in the crowded pressure-sensitive media market, (3) leveraging the existing Tedlar partnership to develop new SKUs for architectural, wall protection, and transit interior applications where GF has manufacturing capacity but limited Tedlar penetration, (4) reducing warranty exposure and customer complaints by upgrading additional product lines to Tedlar-grade durability. This role owns the product roadmap and portfolio strategy that would drive incremental Tedlar adoption across GF's 400,000+ sq ft manufacturing capacity serving US, Canada, LATAM, and APAC markets.

target_roles.title: Director of Sales
target_roles.rationale: With General Formulations actively exhibiting at ISA Expo 2025 and PRINTING United Expo, partnering with PDAA for vehicle wrap training certification, and wrapping 120+ LA Metro buses, the Director of Sales is on the front lines hearing customer demands for longer-lasting, graffiti-resistant solutions. This role would champion expanding Tedlar usage because: (1) sales teams likely face price objections on premium products—Tedlar's 12-20 year lifespan and reduced TCO provide compelling ROI stories to justify premium pricing and close deals, (2) they hear direct customer complaints about competitive laminates failing prematurely (fading, cracking, graffiti damage)—expanding Tedlar coverage gives them a proven solution to win back lost accounts, (3) the vehicle wrap and transit markets (where GF already uses Tedlar in GF 108 and MetroMark 209) are growing—sales leadership would want to expand the Tedlar-backed product portfolio to capture more fleet and transit RFPs requiring 7-10+ year warranties, (4) co-exhibiting with DuPont Tedlar at ISA 2025 signals joint go-to-market potential—sales leadership would want to leverage this partnership for co-selling, case studies, and competitive positioning. This role directly benefits from having more premium, differentiated products to sell into their established distribution channels across North America and global markets.

target_roles.title: VP of Operations
target_roles.rationale: Managing 400,000+ square feet of manufacturing and converting operations across multiple geographies, the VP of Operations at General Formulations would be critical for scaling Tedlar adoption across additional product SKUs beyond GF 108. This role would care about: (1) operational efficiency and yield optimization—converting and laminating Tedlar film requires specific technical expertise; expanding usage across more product lines would benefit from standardized processes and supplier consolidation with an existing trusted partner, (2) quality metrics and warranty claim reduction—if non-Tedlar laminates are generating field failures, defects, or customer returns, upgrading to Tedlar's proven durability (no yellowing, UV degradation, graffiti resistance) directly improves operational KPIs and reduces costly rework, (3) supply chain reliability and inventory management—deepening the existing Tedlar partnership provides supplier stability and potentially better pricing/terms for higher volume commitments across multiple SKUs, (4) capacity utilization—with established converting capabilities, adding Tedlar-backed premium SKUs allows GF to drive higher revenue per square foot of manufacturing capacity without major capex investment. Given that GF already successfully manufactures GF 108 Tedlar laminate, Operations has proven competency to scale Tedlar into wall protection, architectural graphics, and transit interior applications where the company currently serves customers but may be using less durable alternatives.
